A git repository for the project: created on the first generation, with everything generated in a first commit, made as the user git knows. Later generations commit nothing: review the diff and commit when you want.

```esquadro
blueprint git
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `initial_commit` | bool | `true` | Commit everything on the first generation. |
| `message` | string | `"chore: generate project with esquadro"` | Message of the first commit. |
| `branch` | string | `"main"` | The branch a new repository starts on, whatever git's own default is; with branching, its main option decides. |

```esquadro
blueprint git {
  initial_commit true
}
```

## Hooks

- `post-gen` init
